messages:
maria: Quick sync — planning to push the service v2.4.1 at 10:30 PT. Need a quick run through of fallback/rollback readiness before we flip the switch.

alex: I can own smoke tests and realtime logs. Will be at my desk from 10:15.

sanjay: I can be on rollback if needed. Shared runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fallback-v2.4.1 (edits from last dry-run included).

maria: Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) confirm rollback command + expected downtime, 2) list go/no-go signals for abort. Keep replies short.

alex: Rollback command (k8s):
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-service inference=redwood/inference:v2.4.0 --record
# then monitor pods: kubectl get pods -l app=inference -w
```
Expect ~90s for pods to become Ready, ~3 mins for warm caches to rehydrate so some latency jitter for first few minutes.

sanjay: Go/no-go signals:
- errors > 0.5% for 3m OR
- p50 latency > 300ms sustained for 5m OR
- failed canary requests >= 10 in 2m
If any triggered, start rollback.

taylor: Ops checklist I run:
1) Confirm DB migration was already applied (it was)
2) Verify autoscale limits set (checked)
3) Confirm alert routing to oncall (checked)
4) Snapshot config/flags (done)

maria: Good. Who's oncall for platform at rollout window? @ops-bot what's current oncall?

ops-bot: Current oncall: taylor (platform). Escalation: platform-sre -> eng-oncall.

alex: Also note: we have an automatic fallback policy if nodes drop below 60% capacity — traffic routes to read-only replica. That should keep internal errors low but will increase latency.

sanjay: If we rollback, I'll coordinate with release-shepherd to pause new traffic and run the image revert above. Maria, pls confirm rollback approve flow.

maria: Approve flow: 
- Pager line + #eng-releases ack from release lead (that's me) + update ticket in Jira (DEP-987). If alex + sanjay confirm rollback started, I give the thumbs up.

alex: I'll post status messages in this thread when smoke starts and when it's clear (or if I see problems).

taylor: Quick note: runbook includes a temporary config toggle to reduce batch size if latency spikes; can help avoid rollback. Toggle path: /flags/inference.reduce_batch=true. Use only if safe.

maria: Final checklist before deploy at 10:30 PT:
- alex: smoke owner ✅
- sanjay: rollback owner ✅
- taylor: platform oncall & toggles ✅
- ops-bot: alerts set ✅
- jira: DEP-987 updated with deploy window ✅

maria: If everyone ✅, i'll kick at 10:30. Otherwise shout now. :thumbsup:

alex: ✅

sanjay: ✅

taylor: ✅

maria: Kicking in 2 mins. I'll post a short postmortem template link after the window for anything unusual.

alex: Noted, I'll capture metrics slice for the first 10 mins.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled by maria at 1765012345, window 10:30-11:00 PT.

maria: Thanks team — chat back here if you see anything off.
